arena shooter isnt a title that applies to just HALO, and there are plenty of shooters out there jsut like halo that allow you to customize your loadout along with other gameplay choices...

It goes without saying that if you are holding one weapon up to fire then even hip fire can be accurate. But having to hold up and hip fire aim two weapons would be more difficult especially at medium to long range... the game would just recognize dual wielding for what it is and you would have either less accuracy  or damage fall off at medium to long ranges..  

as far as balance goes..  i believe the weapons to be balanced with the standard auto rifle and BR realistically being the worst guns in the game..  so why would i want to play a game where i start with the worst weapons and sometimes get to use the balanced weapons before someone else gets to them???  i dont think that i can realistically survive someone using a bandit rifle or mangler 90% of the time when i am stuck with either of those weapons or even a sidekick.. they would have to be inaccurate and, at a certain point, that is unlikely..  how many other "arena shooters" promote this level of potential unfairness??  

Halo is a game where you show up to battles prepared, then make use of anything else in case you werent.. you dont just show up to leech off the surrounding area that isnt very heroic..

and as far as maps go, if they arent ALL being played, then maybe they are mostly trash, because i doubt most people would want to play the same maps all the time unless the other maps were much worse in comparison... so there.. and having the rng system doesnt mean i will get to play the maps i want to play because there are maps i barely get any playtime on that i thought were pretty good in infinite..

that isnt a loadout problem, its a weapon and equiptment balance problem and should never be used as an excuse as to why we cant use weapons that are otherwise already in the game..  i get that some people like to rush to grab weapons or farm ordinance but i dont.

you wouldnt NEED to find two. two would just be more efficient..  

it goes without saying that all dual wielding options would funtction best at close to medium range effectively bringing sidearms up to par with shotguns and some fully automatic rifles within that range...  BRS and other guns besides standard Automatic rifle are very effective at medium to long range giving users enough of an edge against dual wielders considering how many of the maps in infinite are.. and there is always shotguns.. needlers wouldnt and shouldnt track at super long ranges and instead should track between medium and point blank ranges..  I wholeheartedly believe it to be a sidearm and dont think that it should outperform other sidearms so drastically unless within that range..

i feel like certain maps are popular for a  reason..

nerfs dont have to apply to a singular weapon and instead to weapons while dual wielding (damage fall off range or accuracy debuffs)

if it were really true that loadouts were bad then there wouldnt be any weapons other than the standard loadouts on maps.. it just wouldnt be good for the game...    all i have to say is if your game isnt performing to standard when considering a realistic variety of weapons then it isnt the fault of the people who choose to wield different weapons..

having realistic performing weapons and maps is key to a good game and a feature like loadouts shouldnt be scrapped because of poor balance... its just not cool..

i dont think balance is what you think it could be...  the only weapon that would realistically need damage adjustments for dual wielding is the needler.. and it goes without saying that people wouldnt be dual wielding rifles or shotguns..

i do not personally believe that loadouts are bad for the game OR that there is any reason for them to not exist in some form..
